description: A repair bench runs the length of the room under a rack of task lamps, every one of them aimed at the same square foot. Dead machines are stacked along the far wall in the order they came in, each with a tag wired to it. The floor is swept. The bench is not, and never will be, because a swept bench is a bench nobody is using.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
